Chapter 725: Chapter 20 The Nine Powerhouses (Subscribe Please)_3

Chapter 725: Chapter 20 The Nine Powerhouses (Subscribe Please)_3

After all, the realm of his true self was there.

“This is the most powerful collection of war videos from nine Ancestor Witches I have gathered,” Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, thought slightly, and an illusory screen appeared in front of him, beginning to play the video.

The sources of these videos were the memories of powerhouses who had witnessed the battles of those nine Ancestor Witches.

Lin Yuan immediately looked towards the video.

The first video displayed a four-armed figure walking on a flat wasteland, with numerous presences lurking around him in all directions.

“You ants, dare to surround and attack me?”

...

The tone of the four-armed figure was contemptuous as he stepped forward, his right foot stomping violently on the ground.

Boom, boom, boom.

Terrifying power spread out in all directions, tearing the ground apart as if the sky had collapsed, and every one of the ambushing Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses suffered heavy injuries.

Just one stomping unleashed such fearsome power that the surrounding Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses suffered heavy casualties.

The four-armed figure took another step forward and arrived in front of a powerhouse with sixteen pairs of wings on his back.

This sixteen-winged powerhouse was also at the Ancestral Witch Realm, desperately defending against the four-armed figure.

But in the end, the four-armed figure just extended his four arms and with a gentle rip, the sixteen-winged powerhouse was torn apart, blood splattering the ground.

Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, explained, “This battle stemmed from the Tianyu Clan powerhouses’ ambush plan. The one being ambushed was one of the ‘Four Divine Kings’ of the Star Alliance, a unique life in the universe, a Tier 11 of the Sixth Tier, on the same level as the ‘Mother of the Tree Realm’.”

Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, expressed a hint of astonishment in his tone.

Although he was also at Eleventh Rank, he was still far from the perfection of the ‘Four Divine Kings’ at the Eleventh Rank.

“Indeed very strong,” Lin Yuan nodded.

This Four Divine King had obviously become an Ancestor Witch for some time, and his grasp and use of his own power had reached an inconceivable extent.

“This Four Divine King is, so far, the strongest among the Myriad Tribes’ powerhouses that have descended,” Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, sighed.

He continued playing the second video.

It was a fight between two Ancestral Witch-level powerhouses.

Both sides unleashed immense terrifying auras, one was burly like a small hill, whereas the other was slender but wielded a blood-colored long knife.

From the auras, it was obvious that the burly figure was stronger, but the actual battle was incredibly fast.

As soon as they clashed, the slender figure holding the blood-colored long knife sliced through the air, and the burly figure was cut in half.

“This?”

Lin Yuan’s pupils slightly constricted.

A one-hit kill?

How could this be?

Even the Four Divine King, when killing the Tianyu Clan’s Ancestor Witch, had to make several moves.

But now, the slender figure had killed his opponent in a second?

“Is it the knife?”

Lin Yuan instantly noticed the blood-colored long knife in the hands of the slender figure.

The knife was so sharp it seemed to tear through the void.

“Is it an oddity? A Supreme Weapon?” Lin Yuan immediately thought of the bronze compass he had acquired.

Despite the distance of the video, the bronze compass gave him a similar aura.

“Yes, it’s the knife,” confirmed Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, nodding. “The wielder is called ‘Hou Zhu,’ an Eleventh Rank Powerhouse of the Prison Tribe, who was at about the Fourth Layer of Tier 11 before falling into the Two-dimensional World.”

“Hou Zhu’s strength was not outstanding among the many Eleventh-Rank beings, but because of this knife, he soared to become the strongest next to the Four Divine Kings.”

Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, paused for a moment and continued, “In the Two-dimensional World, there are many oddities. These oddities are likely at the Twelve-Star Level, capable of exerting some extraordinary power under the suppression of the Two-dimensional World.”

“`

“So that’s how it is.”

Lin Yuan whispered.

In fact, he had known about the existence of these special artifacts for quite some time, and he even still had one on hand.

“The effects of these artifacts vary, but they all have significant uses. Many Ancestral Witches are now searching for them everywhere,” Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master, said.

Take the ‘Hou Zhu’ of the Prison Tribe as an example, who soared to the heavens with the help of a blood-colored long knife.

Next.

Lin Yuan continued to watch the third, fourth, fifth… videos.

So far, the strongest nine Ancestral Witches recognized in the Two-dimensional World include six special life forms.

The remaining three are one from the Prison Tribe, one from the Yu Clan, and one from human civilization.

The Yu Clan, among the peak clans, is arguably the most powerful, with nine Supreme Beings like human civilization, but with a history far more ancient.

They are a terrifying clan that was born at the dawn of the universe.

“Our human civilization’s Ancestral Witch barely ranks ninth,” Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master, said with a shake of his head.

That’s still not bad, as other peak clans like the Insect Race and the Tianyu Clan didn’t even make it into the top nine.

“Are there more videos?” Lin Yuan wanted to see the battle videos of other Ancestral Witch level powerhouses.

“There are,” Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master, nodded.

Lin Yuan continued to watch for a while.

Sure enough.

Starting with the tenth Ancestral Witch, there was a significant gap in strength compared to the previous nine.

“Tuoba Ancient God?” Lin Yuan looked at the twelfth video.

It meant that the powerhouse in this video was ranked twelfth among the powerhouses of the Myriad Tribes.

“Tuoba Ancient God is also a special life form with a great innate talent,” Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master, commented on the side.

This time, the Two-dimensional World is definitely the home turf for these special life forms; in terms of talent, they are unquestionably the strongest.

“By the way, Galaxy Master, what realm have you cultivated to now?” Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master, asked with curiosity.

“Just entered the Witch Emperor Realm,” Lin Yuan shook his head.

“That is very impressive,” Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master, said in praise.

Although Lin Yuan is known as the greatest evolutionary genius in the history of human civilization, he has just entered Tier 10, which is fundamentally different from those at Tier 11.

Even so, to have stepped into the Witch Emperor Realm after just over twenty years is on par with the cultivation speed of ordinary Eleventh-Rank Life.

Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master, had also only recently entered the Witch Emperor Realm.

In fact, of the more than three hundred Eleventh-Rank Lives that fell into the Two-dimensional World, the majority are still at the Witch Emperor level.

What Nalan didn’t know was that Lin Yuan’s so-called entry into the Witch Emperor Realm already allowed him to match an Ancestral Witch.

And in terms of potential development, even the ‘Four Divine Kings,’ who are the strongest, are far from comparable to Lin Yuan.

The Four Divine Kings have already reached the Ancestral Witch Realm, and their rate of cultivation will definitely slow down substantially, but Lin Yuan, who is just a Witch Emperor, still has a vast space for improvement.

And the closer to the limit, the greater Lin Yuan’s advantage becomes.

…

After finishing his conversation with Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master,

Lin Yuan continued to immerse himself in refining and developing the Ancestor Witch Cultivation Skill.

Time flew by.

And a hundred years passed.
